title: klein-four-group
description: The abelian group ℤ₂ × ℤ₂ of order 4 — generated by `instantiating` an abelian group at order 4. The symmetry group of the four-valued bilattice (negation and conflation).

order.description: the group has exactly four elements

presentation.description: two independent involutions a, b with a² = b² = (ab)² = e

bilattice-symmetry.description: acts as the symmetry group of the four-valued bilattice {⊥,t,f,⊤} via negation (t↔f) and conflation (⊥↔⊤)
